rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is caring, dedicated, or wholehearted rather than specifically romantic.

example.english: You’re so devoted to helping me; you even made me a birthday cake.
example.traditional: 你咁有心幫我整生日蛋糕，我真係好感動。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 jau5 sam1 bong1 ngo5 zing2 saang1 jat6 daan6 gou1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 dung6

rows.note: Use this when devoted means having a strong emotional bond with a person or thing, especially family members.

example.english: They have always been deeply devoted to their grandmother.
example.traditional: 佢同阿嫲一向好有感情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tung4 aa3 maa4 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 jau5 gam2 cing4

rows.note: Use this for deep, usually romantic attachment rather than ordinary fondness or dedication.

example.english: They’re so devoted to that girl that they have still been waiting for her for years.
example.traditional: 佢對個女仔咁痴心，幾年都仲等緊佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 go3 neoi5 zai2 gam3 ci1 sam1 gei2 nin4 dou1 zung6 dang2 gan2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for someone zealous or enthusiastic about a cause, activity, or responsibility.

example.english: They are very devoted to community work.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 se5 keoi1 gung1 zok3 hou2 jit6 sam1
